articles.title: Four species of aliens have been pulled from crashed UFOs: ex-government researcher
articles.summary: A former CIA-funded government researcher, Dr. Hal Puthoff, sensationally claimed this week that the US has recovered four distinct species of extraterrestrial life from crashed UFOs. This assertion from a figure involved in advanced aerospace research sparks significant debate regarding potential contact and the existence of alien life, with profound implications if substantiated.

articles.summary: On May 16, 2026, General Valery Gerasimov, Chief of the General Staff and First Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation, reportedly conducted an inspection. articles.title: Putin's four horsemen of the apocalypse: A nuke that orbits earth before striking anywhere, a torpedo that sparks radioactive tsunamis, a 14-storey high mega missile and Star Wars space weapon
articles.summary: Reports indicate Russian President Vladimir Putin is quietly developing a terrifying arsenal of 'superweapons.' These advanced military capabilities, being assembled deep within Russia's defense apparatus, are speculated to possess immense destructive power, potentially capable of coercing or overpowering nations. articles.title: Telangana cops issue Look Out Circular against Union Minister Bandi Sanjay’s son in POCSO case
articles.summary: Telangana Police have issued a Look Out Circular (LoC) against Bandi Sai Bhageerath, son of Union Minister of State for Home Bandi Sanjay Kumar. The LoC is in connection with a POCSO case registered against him. This development signals a significant legal action involving a high-profile political family member, underscoring ongoing efforts in law enforcement.

articles.title: Delhi High Court asks CCI not to pass final orders in Apple investigation
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has instructed the Competition Commission of India (CCI) to halt final orders in its ongoing probe against Apple. The investigation centers on Apple's alleged anti-competitive conduct concerning its App Store. This directive temporarily pauses the CCI's proceedings, underscoring significant national regulatory scrutiny into a major global tech company's market practices within India, impacting digital market competition.

articles.title: 'If Pakistan harbours terrorists, operates against India...': Army chief's stern message
articles.summary: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi issued a stern warning to Islamabad, stating that if Pakistan persists in harbouring terrorists and acting against India, they would face decisive action. This strong military message underscores India's zero-tolerance policy on terrorism and commitment to national security, signaling a firm stance against cross-border threats from Pakistan-backed elements.
